cues: Hi, and welcome to Healthy Habits at Work.
In about fifteen minutes, you'll pick up small changes to how you move, breathe and connect, that add up to calmer, more focused days.
Press Start whenever you're ready.
First things first.
What should I call you?
Type your name below, and I'll use it as we go.
Here's the plan.
Three small habits: move, breathe and connect.
Open each card to see what's inside.
When you've explored all three, the ring fills up.
Move.
Your body is built for motion, not eight hours in one chair.
Small, frequent movement beats one long workout.
Breathe.
One minute of slow breathing can calm a racing mind between tasks.
Connect.
A short walk and a real conversation lift your mood more than another message thread.
Lesson one.
Move.
Let's start where you spend most of your day: your desk.
Your desk should fit you, not the other way round.
Tap each marker to check your screen, your chair and your feet.
Screens make our eyes work hard.
Try the twenty, twenty, twenty rule.
Every twenty minutes, look at something twenty feet away, for twenty seconds.
Start the timer and give it a go.
Lovely.
Your eyes thank you.
Myth or fact?
Flip each card to find out.
Now sort these habits.
Drag each one to helps, or hurts.
Quick check.
Pick the best answer, then press Submit.
Lesson two.
Breathe.
When the day speeds up, your breath is the quickest way to slow it down.
Follow the circle.
Breathe in as it grows.
Hold for a moment.
And breathe out slowly, as it shrinks.
Here's a reset you can do anywhere, in four simple steps.
Open each step in turn.
How are you feeling today?
Move the sliders.
There are no wrong answers, and nothing here is scored.
Lesson three.
Connect.
People who feel connected at work are happier, and they do better work too.
Let's try a real moment.
Your afternoon is packed, and a colleague asks if you'd like a quick walk.
What would you do?
Here's what a healthy day can look like, hour by hour.
Tap each point on the timeline.
Six quick wins you can try this week.
Tap each tile to reveal it.
Now make it yours.
Choose the habits you'll try this week, and how many minutes you'll give them.
Time for the final quiz.
Six questions, and you'll need eighty percent to pass.
Take your time.
Great work.
You passed!
Your certificate is ready for you.
Not quite this time.
Have another look at the lessons, and try again.
You're nearly there.
Before you go, a few reflections.
These aren't scored.
They're just for you.
Here's your certificate.
You've earned it.
Well done.
Remember: small habits, repeated often, make the biggest difference.
See you tomorrow, a little healthier.
A bonus tip: blink more.
When we stare at screens, we blink about half as often.
A few slow blinks keep your eyes comfortable.
